title: $L_p$ Minkowski problem and Brunn-Minkowski inequality for dual quermassintegrals
summary: This paper studies the core problems in the $L_p$ dual Brunn-Minkowski theory, encompassing the $L_p$ Minkowski problem and $L_p$ Brunn-Minkowski inequality for dual quermassintegrals. For the case $0<p<q\leq n$, we establish $C^0$ estimates for the $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem without symmetric assumptions, thereby resolving a related problem proposed by Böröczky-Chen-Liu-Saroglou in the smooth sense.
